messages:
ines: Strange bug in Electron quickstart: streaming JSON parse errors when token refresh happens mid-response.

ines: Repro steps: start long generation, force short auth TTL, let refresh occur. Sometimes client throws 'Unexpected end of JSON input'.

omar: Do we see it in plain Chrome or only Electron?

ines: Only Electron so far. Node SDK in CI seems okay.

rui: Likely cause: ad-hoc SSE handler tries to JSON.parse each received chunk. If chunk breaks a JSON token, parse fails. Also CRLF vs LF differences on Windows/Electron.

ines: Quick local fix I used: accumulate chunks, normalize CRLF, split on '

', keep tail as buffer and only parse completed events. Works around multibyte split.

omar: We should add a shared sse-reassembly util to SDKs (node/browser) and add tests for: multibyte char split, escaped unicode split, and auth-refresh-inserted-chunk.

ci-bot: ci/test-matrix queued: electron-windows, electron-mac, node-ubuntu.

ines: Opened PRs: sampleapp fix + tests and node-sdk helper. Will link when up.

rui: Also add a small async-iterator API so sampleapps can do: for await (const ev of sseEvents(resp.body)) { handle(ev) }

omar: Good. Add telemetry when we detect mid-stream auth refresh to measure occurrence.

ines: I'll update devex README with a short note and code snippet. Follow-ups tracked in issue SDK-2901.
